fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at c3bc52840 with a binary built from the branch, real ~/.cache. In a scratch Rhiza root and repo, a workflow with [env] GOTMPDIR = "{run_tmp}": the step saw GOTMPDIR=~/.cache/rhiza/run-tmp/<run id>, present during the step, git rev-parse there said 'not a git repository', go env GOTMPDIR agreed, nothing under the repo's .git/rhiza/runs/*/tmp; after the run its folder was gone and a sibling folder and the parent stayed. A second workflow step ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ci-install|workflow-env)$' with GOTMPDIR={run_tmp}: ok, and git status of the checkout showed no new file (no .github/workflows/rhiza.yml). A third run was killed -9 mid-step, then rhiza run abandon removed only its own run-tmp folder, keeping the sibling and the run-tmp parent. Scoped tests with GOTMPDIR in the scratchpad pass: TestScripts/workflow-env, ./internal/run/..., ./internal/api -run 'TestSessionRunWorkflowEnv$|Abandon|GoTmp'; the host's ~/.cache/rhiza/run-tmp was empty before and after.

QA cycle 2 at c3bc52840: with this run's own GOTMPDIR (~/code/rhiza/.git/rhiza/runs/<run>/tmp), go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/ci-install$' fails before the script runs ('inside a git dir: set GOTMPDIR outside the repository') and ~/code/rhiza/.github/workflows holds no rhiza.yml; with GOTMPDIR in the session scratchpad, TestCheckWorkOutsideRepo and TestScripts/ci-install pass.
